falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 78% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at ~5,100; this would confirm a lower-low structure and negate the bottoming thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at ~28; sustained readings above 35 would indicate a volatility regime exceeding that bottom's stress levels, breaking the pattern's risk-profile similarity and suggesting a deeper liquidation phase rather than a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.75% while S&P 500 is simultaneously below 5,200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety panic (rates plunging with stocks) rather than the August 2024 bottom dynamic where yields stabilized and stocks recovered; it invalidates the soft-landing/growth-stabilization narrative embedded in the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
